title: Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior de HTML – Modelos de E-mail (Salesforce Marketing Cloud)
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) Sênior de HTML – Modelos de E-mail (Salesforce Marketing Cloud)

Brasil - Modelo de trabalho: Remoto


Sobre a Motivus

Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Visão Geral da Posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior de HTML com experiência em Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) , especialmente em configuração de modelos e Cloud Pages , para desenvolver templates de e-mail e landing pages de alto desempenho, responsivos e dinâmicos. Você terá um papel fundamental na criação da estrutura global de e-mails , garantindo escalabilidade, reutilização e consistência de marca em todas as campanhas.

Essa função exige uma combinação sólida de habilidade técnica, pensamento criativo e atenção aos detalhes . Você colaborará de perto com equipes de marketing, design, dados e gestão de campanhas para entregar experiências digitais impactantes que envolvam milhões de clientes.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a codificação e otimização de modelos de e-mail modulares, reutilizáveis e responsivos dentro do Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Desenvolver e implementar conteúdo personalizado e dinâmico usando AMPscript e Data Extensions .
  • Trabalhar em parceria com equipes de marketing para traduzir requisitos de negócio e designs criativos em soluções de e-mail eficientes e escaláveis.
  • Estabelecer e manter padrões de codificação de e-mail , garantindo compatibilidade entre clientes, acessibilidade e consistência da marca .
  • Supervisionar testes de QA e renderização em vários dispositivos e clientes de e-mail usando ferramentas como Litmus .
  • Diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos relacionados a renderização, rastreamento e entregabilidade.
  • Revisar códigos e compartilhar melhores práticas para desempenho e manutenção.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências do setor , atualizações do SFMC e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e entregabilidade de e-mails .


Qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia em Marketing ou área relacionada (ou experiência equivalente).
  • Experiência total em TI de 7 a 9 anos , sendo 5+ anos com desenvolvimento de templates de e-mail e pelo menos 2 anos em Salesforce Marketing Cloud .
  • Conhecimento avançado em HTML, CSS e design responsivo voltado para clientes de e-mail.
  • Proficiência em AMPscript , conteúdo dinâmico e personalização baseada em dados .
  • Experiência comprovada em testes de QA, troubleshooting e otimização para diferentes dispositivos e clientes de e-mail.
  • Sólida compreensão de entregabilidade, acessibilidade e conformidade de e-mails (CAN-SPAM, GDPR).
  • Excelente atenção aos detalhes , boa gestão de tempo e habilidades de colaboração .
  • Inglês avançado.


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?

  • Desenvolva sua Carreira : Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes : Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo : Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente : Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores

  • Cultura de Inovação : Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade : Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento : Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.

title: Cloud Native Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Senior Cloud Native Developer to join our growing team. We are proud to deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and international development teams.


About the role:


As a Senior Cloud Native Developer , you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable, cloud-native applications using Azure and .NET technologies . You will collaborate with product owners, architects, and cross-functional teams to implement high-quality software solutions that follow modern engineering practices.

This role is ideal for someone with deep technical expertise in Azure cloud services , microservices , and backend development , combined with strong problem-solving abilities and a collaborative mindset.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain cloud-native applications using Azure services , .NET Core , and C# .
  • Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to ensure smooth and automated deployments.
  • Define and manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using Pulumi .
  • Develop microservices and event-driven architectures leveraging Azure Functions , Azure Service Bus , and Cosmos DB .
  • Build and optimize RESTful APIs , ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate closely with architects, QA, and product teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Apply best practices for monitoring , logging , and application performance management .
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:


  • Strong experience in software development with .NET Core and C# .
  • Strong knowledge of Azure cloud services , including Azure Functions , Service Bus , and Cosmos DB .
  • Experience with microservices architecture and event-driven systems .
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts , including hands-on experience with GitHub Actions or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Pulumi , Terraform , or similar frameworks.
  • Experience building and managing containers (Docker) and working with container orchestration platforms (Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of software design principles , clean code , and best engineering practices .
  • Excellent communication skills in English and ability to work collaboratively in distributed, cross-functional teams.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):


  • Experience with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms.
  • Familiarity with Application Insights , Grafana , or other monitoring tools.
  • Understanding of MuleSoft or similar integration platforms.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

title: Brazil -Front-end Developer
description:
In Short

Arke is actively searching for a qualified Front-end developer in Brazil. You'll join our dynamic team, collaborating directly with our Brazil Country Head and fellow developers to create intuitive, appealing, and performant web applications for our clients. We’re looking for someone passionate about crafting outstanding user experiences and eager to stay current with evolving digital technologies.


Code samples are required.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Collaborate with team members and clients to design and implement high-quality solutions based on technical and business requirements.
  • Use modern development standards and tools to create software applications that delight users.
  • Produce detailed documentation, test plans, and maintain well-documented, clean, and efficient code.
  • Foster trusted partnerships with coworkers and clients.
  • Develop interactive prototypes to explore innovative UI solutions.
  • Develop tested and documented TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Build responsive and cross-browser compatible applications optimized for desktop and mobile.
  • Adhere strictly to branding guidelines and UX standards.
  • Maintain positive and productive working relationships with stakeholders, peers, and management.


What We’d Love to See

  • 2–4 years of professional front-end development experience.
  • Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and TypeScript.
  • Proven professional experience using React.
  • Familiarity with Git workflows and branch strategies.
  • Experience with browser compatibility testing and debugging
  • Strong understanding of UI design principles and layout aesthetics.
  • Basic knowledge of SEO best practices.
  • Intermediate spoken English, fluent in written English.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.
  • Have excellent analytical and multitasking skills.
  • Be reliable and dependable, consistently meeting deadlines and commitments.


Nice to have

  • Experience with Next.js.
  • Familiarity with additional front-end frameworks.
  • Experience with content management systems (CMS).
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or related fields.


Who We Are

Arke is a full-service experience design and technology consultancy that believes in providing more – much more. We change the way brands approach digital transformation and create defining moments to better connect brands with their customers. Arke’s core values are the soul of who we are and shape everything we do. We are authentically unique, operate with high standards, and love what we do.

title: Data Scientist - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Data Science Seniors to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work together with developers, tech leads and solution architects to build applications.

- Improve existing structures by adding new functionalities or proposing technological updates so that as a result, the impact of your contribution is significant in the core of each business.

- The result of your work will also allow you to improve the user experience on scalable and high availability platforms, contributing to the key differential of each business.


Requirements:


- 6+ years of experience working as a developer.

- 5+ years of experience working as a Data Scientist.

- Proficient with analysis, troubleshooting, and problem solving.

- Hands-on experience with managing data loads and data quality is a plus.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Consultor(a) Microsoft Dynamics + PowerPlatform Sênior
description:
A Inetum é uma empresa líder global em serviços de TI, dedicada a fornecer soluções inovadoras aos nossos clientes. Estamos comprometidos em promover um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, inclusivo e que preza pela diversidade, onde a criatividade e a colaboração prosperem. Estamos presentes em 19 países e somos mais de 28.000 colaboradores no mundo.


Procuramos um consultor sênior experiente em Dynamics 365 para apoiar o desenvolvimento, aprimoramento e otimização de um ambiente Microsoft Dynamics 365. Essa função envolve trabalhar em casos complexos, projetando e configurando soluções nos módulos Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service e Customer Insights: Journeys, além de utilizar os recursos do Power Platform para automatizar processos de negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Configurar e personalizar os módulos Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service e Customer Insights: Journeys.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções usando Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse).
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações dual-write com Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
  • Apoiar migrações de dados e garantir integridade, escalabilidade e conformidade do sistema.
  • Documentar o trabalho no Jira e Confluence em um ambiente ágil.
  • Entregar soluções de alta qualidade com atenção aos detalhes e à experiência do usuário.


Qualificações

  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência prática com Dynamics 365 CE (Sales, Customer Service, Customer Insights: Journeys).
  • Forte conhecimento em configuração, personalização e design de soluções.
  • Compreensão sólida das capacidades da Power Platform.
  • Experiência com integrações (baseadas em API e dual-write) e migração de dados.
  • Familiaridade com entrega ágil e ferramentas como Jira e Confluence.
  • Certificações Microsoft relevantes para consultores sêniores de D365.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com equipes distribuídas.
  • Experiência em consultoria ou ambientes de entrega baseados em projetos.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.


Informações Adicionais

Horário de trabalho: 6h às 15h (fuso horário da Europa).

Alocação: Superior a 6 meses.

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: EMS Specialist
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a EMS Specialist , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, remote, in Brazil.


In this role you will:

Responsible for the implementation, operation, and optimization of Energy Management Systems (EMS) supporting power generation and transmission networks. This role focuses on ensuring reliable, efficient, and secure operation of the electrical system. Experience in EMS platforms (GE products) required.


Responsibilities:

  • Implement, configure, and maintain EMS platforms for real-time monitoring and control of generation units and transmission assets.
  • Support generation control, frequency and voltage regulation through EMS functionalities.
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on EMS software to generation and transmission environments.
  • Act as a middle between the client and the EMS development team and check if EMS customizations/applications are following the technical specification.
  • Provide technical support and training to operational and engineering teams.
  • Validate EMS data model.
  • Collaborate with SCADA system teams for proper integration.
  • Adjustment of network and generation applications (in run time).
  • Create a valid DTS (Dispatcher Training Simulator) model and test DTS events with the customer.
  • Analyze operational data to identify opportunities for optimizing generation dispatch, transmission flows, and system efficiency.
  • Provide support to project teams by assisting with troubleshooting, application data modeling, and implementing effective solutions.
  • Maintain and organize project documentation, including technical reports and drawings.
  • Provide training to users and operators as needed.


Qualifications / Essential Criteria:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Automation, or related field.
  • Fluency in English (speaking, reading, and writing).
  • Proven experience in EMS platforms (GE products).
  • Strong understanding of transmission/generation system operations.


Desirable Criteria:

  • Ability to work in multidisciplinary teams and communicate technical concepts effectively.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Committed to maintaining the highest standards of service quality in all aspects of project delivery.
  • Good troubleshooting skills: know how to identify and escalate problems that have an impact on the client and / or strategic initiatives.

title: Project Integration Specialist - Brazil
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Project Integration Specialist - Brazil , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

The Project Integration Specialist is responsible for overseeing the integration and coordination of various IT projects within the organization, ensuring that all components of the projects are aligned, executed efficiently, and meet the company's strategic objectives. This professional acts as a technical leader, advisor and mentor, ensuring the cohesion and success of integration projects.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Leadership and Technical Consulting: Acting as a technical lead to ensure that project implementations are aligned with architectural design, guiding cross-functional teams, and fostering communication and collaboration among all stakeholders.
  • End-to-End Solution Design: Develop and implement comprehensive integration plans for IT projects. Assess the compatibility and interoperability of different systems and technologies through thorough testing and evaluation.
  • Project and Resource Management: Plan and manage the timelines and deliverables of integration projects. Allocate and manage resources effectively, including budgeting and staffing. Monitor project progress and performance, ensuring adherence to timelines and budget.
  • Technology Selection and Validation: Conduct technical assessments and feasibility studies for new integration projects to determine the best approach and resources needed. Stay up-to-date on emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Risk Management: Identify and resolve integration issues and technical challenges through troubleshooting and collaboration with technical teams. Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies to ensure projects stay on track.
  • Governance and Compliance: Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices throughout the integration process.
  • Documentation and Continuous Improvement: Prepare and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including integration plans, status reports, and risk assessments. Drive continuous improvement in integration processes and methodologies by analyzing project results and implementing feedback.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT project management , integration, or related field.
  • Systems Integration: Experience with a variety of integration tools and platforms (e.g., middleware, APIs) to facilitate the integration of projects, configuring and maintaining them. Experience in designing integrations between data systems and other enterprise platforms (e.g., ERPs such as SAP, CRMs).
  • Architecture: Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and software development. Experience with software architecture design, including microservices, SOA (Service-Oriented Architecture), and cloud-based architectures.
  • Systems and Tools: Use of integration tools and platforms. Implementation and management of systems to track and report metrics of integration projects, including the configuration of dashboards and monitoring tools.

Languages: Advanced English and/or French.


Soft Skills:

  • Communication and Influence: Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to varied audiences (technical, executive, business). Build strong relationships with stakeholders to ensure their needs are met and foster a collaborative environment.
  • Leadership and Collaboration: Ability to lead by example, working with cross-functional teams and building consensus among stakeholders.
  • Strategic Vision: Ability to think "in the big picture", aligning technological decisions with the company's long-term objectives.
  • Problem Solving: Proactive and analytical profile, engaged in identifying and solving complex challenges.

Organization and Focus: Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and results-focused environment.


Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in a related field.
  • Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) or other relevant certifications. Certifications in cloud architecture (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Solutions Architect).
  • Technologies: Experience with cloud computing and data integration. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Expected Skills:

  • Ensure that the needs of the business are aligned with the architectural vision.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Ensure scalability/performance, security, and quality standards.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement in development processes and existing architecture.
  • Analyze the technological environment and seek possibilities for improvement and standardization in line with strategic planning.
  • Present to stakeholders how the architecture options will meet their needs.

title: Project Manager
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Role Overview

The Project Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, and delivering projects within scope, time, and budget constraints. This role focuses on managing cross-functional teams, ensuring stakeholder alignment, and driving operational excellence across diverse business initiatives. Unlike senior Program Managers, this position emphasizes hands-on project execution rather than portfolio-level strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Project Planning & Execution
  • Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, and resource allocation.
  • Monitor progress and adjust schedules as needed to meet deadlines.
  • Ensure adherence to organizational project management methodologies.
  • Stakeholder Communication
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project updates.
  • Prepare and present status reports to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Risk & Issue Management
  • Identify potential risks early and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Escalate critical issues promptly to leadership.
  • Budget & Resource Management
  • Track project budgets and ensure cost-effective delivery.
  • Coordinate with resource managers for staffing needs.
  • Quality Assurance
  • Maintain compliance with internal standards and client expectations.
  • Conduct post-project reviews and implement lessons learned.


✅ Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, IT, or related field.
  • PMP certification preferred (or equivalent like PRINCE2).
  • Project management experience in IT or business domains.
  • Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (Waterfall, Agile).
  • Proficiency in tools like MS Project, JIRA, Confluence.

  • Ei Profissional de Release Manager Mobile - PL, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Buscamos um profissional para gerenciar as releases dos aplicativos mobile de um grande cliente, garantindo entregas estáveis, automatizadas e de alta qualidade nas lojas da Google Play e Apple App Store .

⚙️ Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar o processo de build e publicação de aplicativos Android e iOS.
  • Controlar versionamento e merge de branches no Git.
  • Garantir o fluxo contínuo de entregas em ambientes mobile.
  • Atuar em parceria com times de desenvolvimento, QA e DevOps para garantir previsibilidade e qualidade nas releases.

✅ Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Conhecimento prático do processo de build e publicação de aplicativos Android e iOS.
  • Domínio de Git , incluindo merge de branches e versionamento.

Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência com CI/CD , automação de builds e pipelines.
  • Conhecimento sobre versionamento semântico e boas práticas de entrega contínua.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento mobile (ex: Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics).

title: Android Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Android Senior Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Able to work independently with minimal supervision, as well as collaborate with a diverse team.

- Accountable for resolution of the most technically challenging issues facing the organization.

- Write code with increasing quality and maintainability.

- Guide the architecture of large features which impact all parts of the company, identifying issues and raising concerns/blockers for mitigation.

- Research and introduce new technology to improve the applications and/or the development pipeline.


Requirements:


- 6+ years of experience in development.

- 5+ years of experience in Android development.

- Solid knowledge of design and architecture patterns.

- Solid knowledge and management of programming fundamentals including algorithms and data structures.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Engenheiro de Dados Senior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Requisitos

Conhecimento Técnico

  • Desenvolvimento Python;
  • Gcp Big Query;
  • Administracao De Bancos Relacionais E Nosql;
  • Expressoes Regulares (Regex);
  • Parsing;
  • Apis E Scripts (Python, Shell, Powershell);
  • Administracao De Banco De Dados Sql Server;
  • (Jenkins, Gitlab Ci, Github Actions;
  • Gcp Dataflow;
  • Api Rest Json.


Responsabilidade

  • Mapear todos os fluxos de dados e pipelines que manipulam ou armazenam CNPJ.


  • Ajustar processos de ETL, transformações e integrações que dependam do tamanho ou formato do CNPJ.


  • Analisar e atualizar schemas, dicionários de dados e data lakes.


  • Implementar validações automatizadas de consistência e qualidade de dados.


  • Apoiar equipes de desenvolvimento (Java, .NET, Cobol) na integração com novos formatos.


  • Gerar relatórios de impacto e apoiar testes de regressão de dados após migração.


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Desenvolvedor web
description:
Para fazer parte do time da 4D , buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Web com visão analítica , foco em performance e domínio das plataformas de mídia .

Nosso objetivo é escalar resultados com inteligência, criatividade e estratégia — conectando marcas às pessoas certas, na hora certa, com a mensagem certa.


A 4D atua em horário comercial , das 9h às 18h , de segunda a sexta-feira , com clientes em todo o Brasil: promotoras de crédito, clínicas médicas, restaurantes, e-commerces e muito mais.

A contratação é no modelo PJ , sendo necessária a emissão de NF (MEI válido) .



Principais Responsabilidades


  • Domínio de WordPress , incluindo desenvolvimento de temas e plugins personalizados ;
  • Experiência prática com Gutenberg e criação de blocos customizados (Block Editor) ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em PHP (orientação a objetos, boas práticas e performance);
  • Conhecimento em HTML5, CSS3 e JavaScript (ES6+) ;
  • Experiência com REST API (integração e consumo de endpoints externos e internos);
  • Familiaridade com MySQL (estrutura de banco de dados e queries otimizadas);
  • Noções de SEO técnico e boas práticas de performance e segurança em WordPress;
  • Experiência com Git (versionamento de código e fluxos colaborativos).



Perfil Desejado


  • Atenção aos detalhes e foco em qualidade de código e usabilidade ;
  • Boa capacidade de tradução de layouts (Figma) em código funcional;
  • Organização e autonomia para gerenciar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente;
  • Comunicação clara e facilidade de colaboração com equipes de design e marketing;
  • Interesse por melhoria contínua e aprendizado de novas tecnologias;
  • Comprometimento com prazos e entregas consistentes .



Benefícios


  • WellHub – Acesso a mais de 18.000 academias e parceiros;
  • Participação nos Lucros da empresa mediante metas coletivas;
  • 15 dias úteis de férias flexíveis ao longo do ano;
  • Recesso coletivo no final/início de ano;
  • Day Off no mês do aniversário.



Diversidade e Inclusão


Aqui na 4D , promovemos a diversidade, equidade e inclusão , valorizando as diferenças.

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a todas as pessoas , independentemente de gênero, orientação sexual, crenças, raça/etnia, condições físicas, mentais ou idade .

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description:
DashLX is an innovative technology company specializing in advanced AI solutions, focused on developing intelligent systems that leverage knowledge bases, multi-context processing, and custom autonomous agents. Our environment fosters creativity and technical excellence, enabling the delivery of cutting-edge AI strategies and solutions primarily using the Strands SDK.
Job Responsibilities:
- Lead the development and implementation of AI strategies focused on knowledge bases, MCP, custom agents, and agent swarms
- Design and develop scalable AI solutions including coding assistants, autonomous MCP agents, and chat agents for internal and external use
- Apply object-oriented programming principles and domain-driven design to create robust and maintainable Python applications
- Collaborate with solutions architecture teams to support day-to-day technical decisions and architectural improvements
- Mentor mid-level engineers and guide technical discussions to uphold best practices in AI engineering
- Continuously evaluate and integrate new AI technologies and frameworks to enhance product capabilities
- Work remotely with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables
Required Qualifications:
- 3 to 5+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering or a related technical field
- Proficiency in Python programming with strong object-oriented programming skills
- Experience with domain-driven design methodologies
- Upper-intermediate to fluent English communication skills
- College degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree or higher preferred
- Familiarity with AI solutions architecture and strategy development
- Experience or willingness to work with the Strands SDK and knowledge-base-driven AI agents
Preferred Qualifications:
- Prior experience designing autonomous agent systems or swarms
- Background in building or maintaining coding assistants and chat agents
- Demonstrated leadership in technical teams and AI strategy initiatives
- Experience working in fully remote, agile environments

title: ServiceNow Administrator
description:
Bradford Jacobs has partnered with an award-winning Technology Solution Provider dedicated to protecting and empowering organizations across the central U.S. They deliver innovative, business-aligned solutions in cybersecurity, cloud, infrastructure, Microsoft, Salesforce, and support services.


They are expaniding and looking to add an exprienced SNOW Administrator to the team. WIthing this role you will lead the reporting, analytics, and KPI strategy for the ServiceNow platform—driving data visibility, operational performance insights, and measurable ROI.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own ServiceNow reporting and analytics governance across all modules.
  • Define and standardize KPIs, reporting cadence, and data quality frameworks.
  • Design and build dashboards and reports in Performance Analytics, Reporting, and Visualization tools.
  • Deliver executive and operational dashboards providing real-time service and performance insights.
  • Collaborate with business and platform owners to align reporting with goals and ITIL frameworks.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across ServiceNow, Power BI, and Salesforce.
  • Measure and communicate platform adoption, automation gains, and productivity improvements.
  • Stay current on ServiceNow releases, AI/Now Assist features, and emerging analytics capabilities.


What You Bring:

  • 3+ years of ServiceNow experience (Performance Analytics, Reporting, or Data Visualization).
  • Proven ability to design dashboards across ITSM, CSM, and SPM modules.
  • Strong knowledge of ServiceNow data models, tables, and CMDB relationships.
  • Excellent collaboration, analytical, and presentation skills.


Preferred:

  • Experience in an MSP or multi-client environment.
  • Familiarity with ITIL KPI frameworks (MTTR, SLA, backlog, etc.).
  • Experience with VividCharts, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Exposure to Automation Engine, Flow Designer, or Now Assist analytics.


Certifications (Preferred):

  • ServiceNow CSA, Performance Analytics & Reporting Micro-Certs, ITIL 4 Foundation.

title: Senior Software Engineer React Native
description:
Senior Software Engineer React Native

Location : Brazil(Remote)


The Senior Software Engineer React Native needs to help design and develop software using React Native for the Pluto TV app running on multiple platforms Website iOS Android Fire TV Stick and web based CTVs like Samsung Hisense Vizio and LG.


Key Responsibilities

Develop connected TV mobile and web app features using React Native

Using Test Driven Development principles build unit tests and automated functional tests using tools like Playwright WebDriver API and Appium

Write clean maintainable sharable and efficient cross platform shared code with appropriate abstraction layers to accommodate the nuances of multiple platforms

Collaborate with cross functional teams to define design and ship new features

Continuously discover evaluate and implement new tools and technologies to maximize development efficiency

Ensure high performance quality and responsiveness of applications in various devices with both high and low performance hardware

Identify and correct process bottlenecks fix bugs and maintain CICD pipeline automation using NX Monorepo GitHub Actions Terraform Helm and Harness

Help maintain code quality code organization and test automatization through regular updates to app packages and refactoring of code.


Qualifications

Approximately 5 years of developing Smart TV and mobileweb applications

At least 2 years of cross platform React Native development experience

Proficient in TypeScript

Strong experience with building React Native apps on TV devices Android TV tvOS web based CTVs

Strong experience with performance optimization on low power devices

Strong experience with Zu stand RTK Query Recoil or similar state management libraries

Strong experience consuming REST APIs in desktop and mobile apps

Strong experience with Git JIRA and Agile development methodologies

Strong experience with unit testing and continuous integration

CICD with GitHub Actions and similar platforms

Strong problem solving and debugging skills

Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team

BS degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience


Nice to haves

Experience with Amazon Kepler Vega OS

Experience with Firebase integration

Experience with Data Dog integration

Experience working with React for Web apps using Node Bun backend Next JS Hapi

Experience working with monorepo architectures especially NX

Experience building automated testing

Experience with Reanimated or other animation libraries

Have lead experience on React Native projects

Have experience on other native TV platforms like TVOS or Android TV

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Editorial Designer (Req English)
description:
Fetchly Labs is a cutting-edge company specializing in innovative projects within the technology and media landscape. We focus on delivering high-quality editorial content through sophisticated design for books, magazines, and annual reports, providing a creative and collaborative remote work environment.
Job Responsibilities:
- Design multi-page editorial layouts for books, magazines, and annual reports of 40+ pages using InDesign
- Prepare print-ready files suitable for hardcover book and magazine production
- Collaborate closely with writers and editors to develop content structure and pacing
- Ensure consistent and visually engaging layout design aligned with editorial standards
- Manage file preparation and proofing processes to meet production deadlines
- Incorporate feedback from cross-functional teams to refine design elements
- Maintain organized project files and documentation throughout the editorial design process
Required Qualifications:
- 2-3 years (Intermediate) to 5+ years (Senior) experience in editorial design
- Proficiency in Adobe InDesign for multi-page editorial layouts
- Experience designing 40+ page editorial publications such as books, magazines, or annual reports
- Hands-on knowledge of print production and preparing print-ready files for hardcover or magazine production
- Demonstrated ability to collaborate with writers and editors on content structure and pacing
- Intermediate to fluent English proficiency
- College degree or higher in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field
Preferred Qualifications:
- Advanced skills in layout design and content structuring for print and digital media
- Experience working in remote teams and managing editorial projects independently
- Familiarity with additional design software and print production workflows

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

title: Casting Coordinator
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works.


About Our Search

We are currently looking for a Casting Coordinator to join our client, a global content company with a focus on talent sourcing for dynamic content projects.


What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in casting, story production, or talent interviewing.
  • Strong communication skills in English.
  • Proficiency with various casting resources and familiarity with social media platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Twitch.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to work efficiently under tight deadlines.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and capable of handling multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Positive attitude with flexibility to adapt to last-minute changes and cancellations.
  • Experience with casting databases and familiarity with Monday.com and Google Suite.


What will you do?

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to talent sourcing and casting across innovative content projects.


  • Identify and source emerging talent across social media platforms, staying on top of trends.
  • Post-casting calls aligned with creative outlines for new and ongoing productions.
  • Screen, organize, and categorize auditions, preparing submissions for producer review.
  • Coordinate auditions with talent, agencies, and managers, managing the talent booking process.
  • Maintain a robust casting database with accurate records and updated talent profiles.
  • Collaborate with Performance Managers to validate profiles, negotiate terms, and align schedules.
  • Produce and direct assigned content episodes, ensuring alignment with strategy, budget, and creative goals.
  • Hosting the episodes on Youtube, being on camera as an interviewer.
  • Build strong relationships with the talent to foster positive creative collaborations and ensure smooth productions.
  • Track deadlines, legal requirements, and production specifications for timely and cost-effective delivery.


Are you ready to make an impact in content creation? Apply now with your English CV !

title: Compliance Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and test the company’s internal controls system, ensuring alignment with Brazilian laws and global compliance standards.
  • Oversee the regulatory compliance framework, including corporate policies, compliance testing, and audit readiness.
  • Manage the Asset Segregation framework according to Central

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Engenheiro de instrumentação
description:
Cargo: ENGENHEIRO DE INSTRUMENTAÇÃO E AUTOMOÇÃO


Descrição da posição:

(Vaga preferencial PCD)


Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro de Instrumentação e Automação Industrial com sólida experiência em Projetos conceitual, básico e detalhamento de instrumentação pneumática, hidráulica, eletrônica analógica/digital, modernização da instrumentação, automação, para atuar nas áreas da refinaria do Complexo Boaventura da Petrobras.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Projetos de Instrumentação e Automação Industrial;
  • Execução e revisão de documentos de projetos e consolidação de comentários técnicos;
  • Elaboração e consolidação de comentários técnicos em documentação emitida pela equipe de projeto.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Graduado em engenharia eletrônica, elétrica ou automação;
  • Experiência mínima: 6 (seis) anos nas atribuições definidas para sua respectiva especialidade.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Visão analítica e capacidade de propor melhorias.


Diferencial:

  • Vivência em ambientes industriais regulados (petróleo e gás)
  • experiência nos sistemas Petrobrás.


Informações Adicionais:

  • Local: Refinaria do Complexo Boaventura – Itaboraí/RJ
  • Regime de contratação: CLT
  • Jornada de Trabalho: 40 horas semanais
  • Regime de trabalho: Presencial
  • Salário: R$ R$ 13.340,46


Benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação : R$ 45,45 por dia útil;
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico : extensivo a família.

Se você se identificou com a vaga, ficaremos felizes em receber seu currículo!

title: Video Editor
description:
Job Title: Video Editor (Remote)

Location: 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Compensation: Retainer + Bonuses

Required Assessment:

About Capstone Media

We’re a fast-growing international content agency helping brands, businesses, and creators produce high-performing video content. Our work spans industries, from investor relations to education, entertainment, and beyond.

If you’re ambitious, detail-oriented, and love crafting videos that hook audiences, this is for you.

This role is ideal for ambitious mid-level+ editors looking to grow fast, work with international brands, and level up their skills.

What You’ll Do

  • Edit short & long-form content for social media platforms.
  • Focus on storytelling and strong hooks to boost retention.
  • Ensure clean sound design and polished delivery.
  • Collaborate with our creative team to meet client goals.
  • Stay up to date with modern editing trends and AI tools.

What We’re Looking For

  • Completed assessment (required to be considered).
  • Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or similar.
  • Reliable tools + ability to meet deadlines.
  • Strong creative instincts and attention to detail.
  • Bonus: Portfolio showing versatility across niches.

Why Join Us

  • 100% remote with flexible work options.
  • Work with a team that collaborate to up-skill, together.
  • No micromanagement, just clear expectations and feedback.
  • Clear growth path and competitive pay.
  • Exposure to diverse, exciting projects.
  • Fast feedback and opportunity to level up your craft.
  • Access to creative and AI software.

How to Apply

Ready to join a fast-growing creative team?

  • Complete the required assessment here:
  • (Optional) Share your portfolio + 2-sentence cover letter.
  • Important: Only applicants who complete the assessment will be considered.

title: Analista de Processos SAP (BA) - Segmento Seguros
description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa com propósito? Fazer acontecer inspirando o melhor das pessoas está no DNA da nossa gente. #VemSerNumen


Prezamos por pessoas que:

  • Buscam comprometimento e excelência em suas entregas;
  • Criam e disseminam um ambiente colaborativo, com espírito de equipe, onde a amizade é valorizada;
  • Queiram atuar com profissionais de confiança;
  • E acreditam que o respeito e a humildade são essenciais para o seu dia a dia aqui na Numen.


Se você se identifica com tudo isso e quer ser Numen, não perca a oportunidade de participar desse processo seletivo!


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência no setor de Seguros e/ou Resseguros, com entendimento das principais operações e fluxos de negócio.
  • Vivência na coleta e análise de requisitos, traduzindo necessidades do negócio em visões claras de produto e especificações funcionais.
  • Conhecimento dos processos e estrutura organizacional de empresas do setor, compreendendo suas interdependências e impactos operacionais.
  • Conhecimento em BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation) e capacidade de modelar processos de negócio utilizando essa notação – diferencial desejável.
  • Experiência em mapeamento e análise de processos, incluindo documentação detalhada, identificação de gargalos e riscos.
  • Foco em resultados e melhoria contínua, com mentalidade orientada à entrega de valor e evolução dos processos.
  • Necessário inglês fluente para atuação em times multiculturais.
  • Necessário conhecimento em metodologias ágeis.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Atuar como parceiro(a) dos responsáveis pelos processos, produtos e usuários de negócio, compreendendo detalhadamente os requisitos e necessidades originais.
  • Mapear e desenhar processos As Is, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo processos To Be.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de TI na avaliação do ambiente tecnológico, considerando suas capacidades e limitações.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em histórias de usuário claras e objetivas.
  • Definir critérios de aceitação para validação das histórias de usuário.
  • Elaborar, em conjunto com os responsáveis pelos processos e usuários de negócio, os casos e cenários de teste positivos e negativos.
  • Participar do planejamento de projetos, definição de cronogramas, reuniões diárias e demais rituais necessários.
  • Apoiar usuários de negócio e equipe de TI na validação das soluções desenvolvidas.
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios e materiais de acompanhamento de projetos e atividades.
  • Comunicar de forma proativa as evoluções, bloqueios e riscos identificados ao longo do projeto.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS


  • Modalidade: Atuação 100% remota.
  • Contratação: Efetiva por tempo indeterminado.


BENEFÍCIOS


  • Vale Transporte (para vagas híbridas e presenciais)
  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Swile Shop
  • TotalPass
  • Vittude
  • Assistência Médica Sulamérica
  • Assistência Odonto Sulamérica
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Benefício para filhos PCD
  • Previdência Privada
  • Numen School
  • Parcerias educacionais com FIA, FIAP, Moovi, Wise Up e English Pass.



Quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance e crescer na área de SAP? Candidate-se e vamos juntos construir o futuro da tecnologia na Numen IT!

title: Analista de Processos SAP (BA) - Segmento Seguros
description:
Você quer fazer parte de uma empresa com propósito? Fazer acontecer inspirando o melhor das pessoas está no DNA da nossa gente. #VemSerNumen


Prezamos por pessoas que:

  • Buscam comprometimento e excelência em suas entregas;
  • Criam e disseminam um ambiente colaborativo, com espírito de equipe, onde a amizade é valorizada;
  • Queiram atuar com profissionais de confiança;
  • E acreditam que o respeito e a humildade são essenciais para o seu dia a dia aqui na Numen.


Se você se identifica com tudo isso e quer ser Numen, não perca a oportunidade de participar desse processo seletivo!


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência no setor de Seguros e/ou Resseguros, com entendimento das principais operações e fluxos de negócio.
  • Vivência na coleta e análise de requisitos, traduzindo necessidades do negócio em visões claras de produto e especificações funcionais.
  • Conhecimento dos processos e estrutura organizacional de empresas do setor, compreendendo suas interdependências e impactos operacionais.
  • Conhecimento em BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation) e capacidade de modelar processos de negócio utilizando essa notação – diferencial desejável.
  • Experiência em mapeamento e análise de processos, incluindo documentação detalhada, identificação de gargalos e riscos.
  • Foco em resultados e melhoria contínua, com mentalidade orientada à entrega de valor e evolução dos processos.
  • Necessário inglês fluente para atuação em times multiculturais.
  • Necessário conhecimento em metodologias ágeis.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Atuar como parceiro(a) dos responsáveis pelos processos, produtos e usuários de negócio, compreendendo detalhadamente os requisitos e necessidades originais.
  • Mapear e desenhar processos As Is, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo processos To Be.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de TI na avaliação do ambiente tecnológico, considerando suas capacidades e limitações.
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em histórias de usuário claras e objetivas.
  • Definir critérios de aceitação para validação das histórias de usuário.
  • Elaborar, em conjunto com os responsáveis pelos processos e usuários de negócio, os casos e cenários de teste positivos e negativos.
  • Participar do planejamento de projetos, definição de cronogramas, reuniões diárias e demais rituais necessários.
  • Apoiar usuários de negócio e equipe de TI na validação das soluções desenvolvidas.
  • Preparar e apresentar relatórios e materiais de acompanhamento de projetos e atividades.
  • Comunicar de forma proativa as evoluções, bloqueios e riscos identificados ao longo do projeto.

title: Estagio Administrativo
description:
Sobre a oportunidade:

Estamos em busca de estagiário(a) para o Time Administrativo , que será responsável por apoiar as rotinas operacionais e administrativas relacionadas à gestão de consultores da Avenue Code.


Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar a conferência e aprovação das horas de trabalho dos consultores;
  • Controlar horas extras, férias, atestados, períodos de on call e demais solicitações;
  • Atuar como ponto focal para consultores, orientando sobre procedimentos internos e uso de planilhas e sistemas específicos de clientes;
  • Cobrar o envio semanal e mensal dos apontamentos de horas;
  • Conferir documentação de reembolsos;
  • Solicitar vouchers, coffee breaks, materiais e licenças de software para eventos e demandas internas.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Cursando graduação em Administração, Gestão de Recursos Humanos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Pacote Office (principalmente Excel);
  • Boa comunicação, organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Facilidade para lidar com diferentes públicos e demandas simultâneas;
  • Disponibilidade para estagiar 6h por dia
  • Inglês intermediário para conversação

description:

Home office, modalidade de contratação PJ

  • Liderar e desenvolver o time de Executivos de Vendas

  • Pacote Office avançado
  • Perfil estratégico, comunicativo, flexível e com excelente relacionamento interpessoal
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer – AI

Contract: 6–12 months (extendable)

Location: Remote – Nearshore (EST hours preferred)


Overview

Our client is looking for a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer – AI to join the engineering team. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience building full-stack applications (80% backend / 20% frontend) , with solid expertise in Go, Python, or Node.js on the backend and Angular on the frontend.


This professional will contribute to the development of AI-powered tools and applications , supporting initiatives involving Generative AI . While deep AI expertise is not required, prior experience integrating or using AI tools is highly desirable.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain AI platforms and AI-powered applications.
  • Stay up to date with advancements in AI technologies and explore opportunities for integration.
  • Build, enhance, and maintain scalable web applications with a focus on performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, and SRE.
  • Implement best practices for security, scalability, and software delivery.
  • Contribute to CI/CD processes to ensure smooth and consistent releases.
  • Mentor junior engineers and promote technical excellence within the team.


Requirements

Must-Have Skills:

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong backend experience with Go (preferred) , Python , or Node.js .
  • Frontend experience with Angular (or a similar modern framework).
  • Experience with Azure and API development .
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL (approximately 10–15% of responsibilities).
  • Practical experience with AI tools (e.g., Azure AI Search, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines , Docker , and GitHub .
  • Experience working in distributed teams using Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira or Asana .


Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with Terraform (preferred but not required).
  • Exposure to TypeScript and React .
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or Azure).
  • Previous background in education, finance, or healthcare industries.


Preferred Profile

  • 80% backend (Go, Python, Node.js) and 20% frontend (Angular).
  • Hands-on experience with AI integration or experimentation .
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills in distributed environments.
  • Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and accountability.

Buscamos um Arquiteto .NET com sólida base técnica na stack Microsoft e práticas modernas de arquitetura de software, além de maturidade comportamental para atuar como ponte entre o negócio, a tecnologia e o time de desenvolvimento.


Principais Competências Técnicas

1. Linguagens e Frameworks

  • C# (nível avançado)
  • .NET 6 / 7 / 8 e .NET Core
  • ASP.NET MVC / Web API
  • Entity Framework Core (ORM)


2. Arquitetura e Design

  • Arquiteturas em camadas, limpa (Clean Architecture) e hexagonal
  • Padrões de projeto (Factory, Singleton, Strategy, CQRS, Mediator etc.)
  • DDD (Domain-Driven Design)
  • Microservices e arquitetura orientada a eventos
  • Integração via APIs RESTful e GraphQL


3. Banco de Dados e Persistência

  • SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle


4. Cloud e DevOps

  • Azure: App Services, Functions, Service Bus, AKS, DevOps Pipelines
  • AWS: Elastic Beanstalk, Lambda, RDS, SQS, ECS
  • Contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes
  • CI/CD e versionamento (Git, GitFlow, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps)
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates)



Detalhes da Contratação

  • Modelo remoto
  • Regime PJ – Alocação temporário 1 mês e ½ de projeto, pontual.

title: Promotor de vendas (1)
description:
NOSSO TIME SANGUE LARANJA #VEMSERATAK

Somos uma empresa legitimamente baiana. Uma história com um jeito único, que começou a ser escrita por Teobaldo, mas que evolui a cada dia graças à dedicação de Maria, Antônio, Ana, José, João e de tantos outros milhares de associados no dia a dia.

O Atakarejo segue firme rumo ao crescimento. E é assim, com muito trabalho, disciplina e determinação fazendo o simples muito bem feito, que a empresa continuará rumo à sua visão de ser a melhor empresa de alimentos da Bahia e uma das 10 maiores do Brasil até 2025. Afinal, ter o Sangue Laranja é ter paixão por vencer.

Como é trabalhar aqui:

Quem trabalha no Atakarejo sabe que somos um time e possuímos um jeito único de ser. Trabalhamos com um propósito, temos uma grande visão, uma missão inspiradora e valores verdadeiros que guiam nossas atitudes.

Esse nosso jeito único de ser é o que faz a diferença no dia a dia dos nossos colaboradores e clientes, e deve estar sempre em cada um de nós, é o sangue laranja que corre em nossas veias.

Por isso estamos sempre em busca de novos talentos dispostos a fazer a diferença junto conosco.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
  • Ofertar o cartão Atakarejo;
  • Emitir o cartão;
  • Ofertar outros serviços financeiros;
  • Realizar atendimento pós venda;
  • Acompanhar o plano de comunicação na loja;
  • Cumprir metas inerentes a função e operação;
  • Dentre outras atividades inerentes ao cargo.
Qualificações necessárias:
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Necessário conhecimento com Pacote Office;
  • Desejável experiência com vendas porta-a-porta; telefonia, dentre outros;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Residir em Itapetinga
